83: 	int i = 0;
84: 	int n = 0;

86: 	while (i < MAX_COMMANDS && n < pCli->num_commands) {
87: 		if (pCli->commands[i]->name == NULL) {
88: 			i++;
89: 			continue;
90: 		}

92: 		/* See if partial or full match is expected */
93: 		if (len != 0) {

95: 				s_running_command_index = i;

100: 				s_running_command_index = i;
101: 				return pCli->commands[i];
102: 			}
103: 		}
104: 
105: 		i++;
106: 		n++;
107: 	}

171: 	u16 i;
172: 
173: 	while (s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
174: 	{
175: 		rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
176: 		count = ap_bridge_tx_count();
177: 		if (!count)
178: 		{
179: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
180: 			break;
181: 		}
182: 		length = MIN(count, (u16)sizeof(data));
183: 		length = MIN(length, bk_mb_uart_write_ready(MB_UART0));
184: 		if (!length)
185: 		{
186: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
187: 			break;
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		for (i = 0; i < length; i++)
191: 			data[i] = s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[(s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + i) %
192: 							 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring)];
193: 
194: 		written = bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, data, length);
195: 		if (!written)
196: 		{
197: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
198: 			break;
199: 		}
200: 		if (written < length)
201: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_partial++;
202: 
203: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + written) %
204: 					 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
205: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_bytes += written;
206: 		rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
207: 	}

229: 			line_length ? AP_BRIDGE_LOG_FLUSH_MS : 20);

231: 		bk_mb_uart_poll(MB_UART0);
232: 
233: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
234: 		events = s_ap_bridge.events;
235: 		s_ap_bridge.events = 0;
236: 		ready_set = s_ap_bridge.ready_set;
237: 		ready_clear = s_ap_bridge.ready_clear;
238: 		ready_before = s_ap_bridge.ready_flags;
239: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_set = 0;
240: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_clear = 0;
241: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
242: 
243: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
244: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
245: 		{
246: 			ready_clear |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
247: 		}
248: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= ready_set;
249: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~ready_clear;
250: 		/* poll() may complete recovery in the same iteration that consumes an
251: 		 * older timeout/reset event.  The driver's current state is the final
252: 		 * authority for the MBUART gate, so a stale event cannot clear a newer
253: 		 * READY notification permanently.
254: 		 */
255: 		if (bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0))
256: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
257: 		else
258: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
259: 		s_ap_bridge.link_ready =
260: 			(s_ap_bridge.ready_flags & AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL) ==
261: 			AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL && bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0);
262: 
263: 		if (s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation !=
264: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_generation)
265: 		{
266: 			if (line_length)
267: 				ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
268: 			line_length = 0;
269: 			line_continues = false;
270: 			active_mode = s_ap_bridge.requested_mode;
271: 			s_ap_bridge.output_mode = active_mode;
272: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation =
273: 				s_ap_bridge.mode_generation;
274: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
275: 		}
276: 
277: 		do
278: 		{
279: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
280: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_bytes += input_length;
281: 			if (active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
282: 			{
283: 				if (input_length && !shell_log_raw_data(input, input_length))
284: 					s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
285: 				continue;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
289: 			{
290: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
291: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
292: 				{
293: 					bool complete = input[index] == '\n';
294: 
295: 					ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length,
296: 							     !line_continues);
297: 					line_length = 0;
298: 					line_continues = !complete;
299: 				}
300: 			}
301: 		} while (input_length != 0);
302: 
303: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr && line_length &&
304: 			active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG)
305: 		{
306: 			ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
307: 			line_length = 0;
308: 			line_continues = true;
309: 		}
310: 
311: 		ap_bridge_drain_tx();
312: 
313: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
314: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
315: 		{
316: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
317: 
318: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.link_down++;
319: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET)
320: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.reset++;
321: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT)
322: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.timeout++;
323: 			if ((ready_before & (AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC |
324: 					     AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC)) ==
325: 				(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC | AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC) &&
326: 				(u32)(now - s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms) >= 1000)
327: 			{
328: 				s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms = now;
329: 				BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG,
330: 					"link down event=%x queued=%u ready=%x\r\n",
331: 					events, ap_bridge_tx_count(),
332: 					s_ap_bridge.ready_flags);
333: 			}
334: 			shell_ap_console_link_down();
335: 		}
336: 	}
337: }

404: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
405: {
406: 	u16 written = 0;
407: 
408: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
409: 		return 0;
410: 
411: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
412: 	while (written < length)
413: 	{
414: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
415: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
416: 			break;
417: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
418: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
419: 	}
420: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
421: 	if (written < length)
422: 	{
423: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
424: 	}
425: 	if (written)
426: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
427: 	return written;
428: }

220: 	return uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL && uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0 &&
221: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;
222: }
223: 
224: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
225: {
226: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
227: 
228: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
229: 
230: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
231: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
232: 
233: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
234: 	{
235: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
236: 	}
237: 	else
238: 	{
239: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
243: 	{
244: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
245: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
246: 		tx_fail = 1;
247: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
251: 	{
252: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
253: 		tx_fail = 1;
254: 
255: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
259: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
260: 	#endif
261: 
262: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
263: 
264: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
265: 
266: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
267: 	{
268: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
269: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
270: 	}
271: 	else
272: 	{
273: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
274: 
275: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
276: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
277: 
278: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
279: 		{
280: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
281: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
282: 		}
283: 		else
284: 		{
285: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
286: 
287: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
288: 			{
289: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
290: 			}
291: 
292: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
293: 		}
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
297: 
298: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
299: 	{
300: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
301: 	}
302: 
303: rx_isr_data_xit:
304: 
305: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
306: 	{
307: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
308: 	}
309: 
310: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
311: 
312: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
313: 
314: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
315: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
316: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
317: 	 */
318: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
319: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
320: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
321: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
322: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
323: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
324: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
325: 
326: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
327: 	{
328: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
329: 		{
330: 			/* trigger send! */
331: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
332: 		}
333: 	}
334: 
335: 	return;
336: }

338: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
339: {
340: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
341: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
342: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
343: 
344: 	if (!invalid)
345: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
346: 	else
347: 	{
348: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
349: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
350: 	}
351: 
352: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
353: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
354: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
355: 	 */
356: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
357: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
358: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
359: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
360: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
361: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
362: 
363: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
364: 	{
365: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
366: 		{
367: 			/* trigger send! */
368: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
369: 		}
370: 	}
371: 
372: 	return;
373: }

375: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
376: {
377: 	/* The response carries the current RTS state, but it cannot replace an
378: 	 * outstanding ACK-pool fence.
379: 	 */
380: 	if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req)
381: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
382: 
383: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
384: 	{
385: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
386: 	}
387: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
388: 	{
389: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
390: 	}
391: 	else
392: 	{
393: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
394: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
395: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
396: 		 */
397: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
398: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
399: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
400: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
401: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
402: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
403: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	return;
407: }

409: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
410: {
411: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
412: 
413: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
414: 
415: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
416: 
417: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
418: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
419: 	{
420: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
421: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
422: 		return;
423: 	}
424: 
425: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
426: 
427: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
428: 	{
429: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
430: 	}
431: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
432: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
433: 	{
434: 		tx_fail = 1;
435: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
436: 	}
437: 	else
438: 	{
439: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
440: 	}
441: 
442: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
443: 	{
444: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
445: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
446: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
447: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
448: 	}
449: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
450: 	{
451: 		chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 0;
452: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
453: 		{
454: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
455: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
456: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
457: 			if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get() ==
458: 				PM_MAILBOX_COMMUNICATION_FINISH)
459: 			{
460: 				mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
461: 			}
462: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
463: 		}
464: 	}
465: 
466: 	if (tx_fail)
467: 	{
468: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
469: 		{
470: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
471: 			{
472: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
473: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
474: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
475: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
476: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
477: 			}
478: 			else
479: 			{
480: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
481: 			}
482: 		}
483: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
484: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
485: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
486: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
487: 		{
488: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
489: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
490: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
491: 		}
492: 		else
493: 		{
494: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
495: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
496: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
497: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
498: 		}
499: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
500: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
501: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
502: 		return;
503: 	}
504: 
505: 	/* try next Tx. */
506: 
507: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
508: 
509: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
510: 	{
511: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
512: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
513: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
514: 	}
515: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
516: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
517: 
518: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
519: 	{
520: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
521: 	}
522: 
523: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
524: 	{
525: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
526: 	}
527: 
528: 	return;
529: }

531: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
532: {
533: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
534: 	{
535: 		u8 peer = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
536: 
537: 		if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req &&
538: 			bk_mailbox_ack_slots_used((mailbox_endpoint_t)peer) >=
539: 			MB_UART_ACK_FENCE_WATERMARK)
540: 		{
541: 			chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 1;
542: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
543: 		}
544: 	}
545: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
546: 	{
547: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
548: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
549: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
550: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
551: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
552: 	}
553: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
554: 	{
555: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
556: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
557: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
558: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
559: 	}
560: 	else
561: 	{
562: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
563: 		{
564: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
565: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
566: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
567: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
568: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
569: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
570: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
571: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
572: 		}
573: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
574: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
575: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
576: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
577: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
578: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET;
579: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
580: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
581: 		else
582: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
583: 	}
584: 
585: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
586: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
587: }

589: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
590: {
591: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
592: 
593: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
594: 		return BK_OK;
595: 
596: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
597: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
598: 	chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
599: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
600: 
601: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
602: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
603: 
604: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
605: 		(chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
606: 	{
607: 		return BK_FAIL;
608: 	}
609: 
610: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
611: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
612: 	{
613: 		return ret_code;
614: 	}
615: 
616: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
617: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
618: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
619: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_channel_event);
620: 
621: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
622: 
623: 	return BK_OK;
624: }

626: static bk_err_t mb_uart_deinit(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
627: {
628: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
629: 		return BK_OK;
630: 
631: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, NULL);
632: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, NULL);
633: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
634: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, NULL);
635: 
636: 	mb_chnl_close(chnl_id);
637: 
638: 	chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback = NULL;
639: 	chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback = NULL;
640: 
641: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 0;
642: 
643: 	return BK_OK;
644: }

646: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
647: {
648: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
649: 
650: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
651: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
652: 
653: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
654: 	{
655: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
656: 	}
657: 
658: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
659: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
660: 
661: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
662: 	{
663: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
664: 	}
665: 	else
666: 	{
667: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
671: 	{
672: 		return BK_FAIL;
673: 	}
674: 
675: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
676: 	{
677: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
678: 	}
679: 
680: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
681: 	{
682: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
683: 	}
684: 	else
685: 	{
686: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
687: 
688: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
689: 		{
690: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
691: 		}
692: 		else
693: 		{
694: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
695: 
696: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
697: 		}
698: 	}
699: 
700: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
701: 
702: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
703: 
704: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
705: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
706: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
707: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
708: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
709: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
710: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
711: 
712: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
713: 
714: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
715: 	{
716: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	return ret_val;
720: }

722: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
723: {
724: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
725: 
726: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
727: 	{
728: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
729: 		return BK_OK;
730: 	}
731: 
732: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
733: 
734: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
735: 
736: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
737: 
738: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
739: 
740: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
741: 	{
742: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
743: 	}
744: 
745: 	return ret_val;
746: }

748: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
749: {
750: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
751: 
752: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
753: 
754: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));

796: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
797: {
798: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
799: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
800: 
801: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
802: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
803: 
804: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
805: 	{
806: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
807: 	}
808: 	else
809: 	{
810: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
811: 	}
812: 
813: 	wr_len = data_len;
814: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
815: 		wr_len = rem_len;
816: 
817: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
818: 	{
819: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
820: 	}
821: 	else
822: 	{
823: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
824: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
825: 
826: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
827: 		{
828: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
829: 		}
830: 		else
831: 		{
832: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
833: 
834: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
835: 		}
836: 	}
837: 
838: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
839: 
840: 	/* trigger send! */
841: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
842: 
843: 	return wr_len;
844: }

846: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
847: {
848: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
849: 
850: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
851: 		return 0;
852: 
853: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
854: 
855: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
856: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
857: 
858: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
859: 	{
860: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
861: 	}
862: 	else
863: 	{
864: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
865: 	}
866: 
867: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
868: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
869: 		rd_len = buf_len;
870: 
871: 	if(rd_len == 0)
872: 	{
873: 		return 0;
874: 	}
875: 
876: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
877: 	{
878: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
879: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
880: 	}
881: 	else
882: 	{
883: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
884: 
885: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
886: 		{
887: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
888: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
889: 		}
890: 		else
891: 		{
892: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
893: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
894: 			{
895: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
896: 			}
897: 
898: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
899: 		}
900: 	}
901: 
902: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
903: 
904: 	/* rts assert...... */
905: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
906: 	{
907: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
908: 		{
909: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
910: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
911: 		}
912: 	}
913: 
914: 	return rd_len;
915: 
916: }

114: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
115: {
116: 	u32   cur_time;
117: 
118: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
119: 
120: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
121: 	{
122: 		return 0;
123: 	}
124: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
125: 	{
126: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
127: 		return 0;
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
131: 	{
132: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
133: 	}
134: 	else
135: 	{
136: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
140: 	{
141: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
142: 		return 0;
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
146: 	{
147: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
148: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
149: 		return 0;
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
153: 	{
154: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
155: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
156: 		return 0;
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	return 1;
160: }

220: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
221: {
222: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
223: 	u32    events;
224: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
225: 
226: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
227: 
228: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
229: 
230: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
231: 	{
232: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
233: 		return;
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	while(1)
237: 	{
238: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
239: 
240: 		if(events == 0)
241: 		{
242: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
243: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
247: 		{
248: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
249: 			{
250: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 
254: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
255: 		{
256: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
257: 
258: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
259: 			{
260: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
261: 
262: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
263: 				{
264: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
265: 					{
266: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
267: 						break;  // cpu1 power on.
268: 					}
269: 				}
270: 				else
271: 				{
272: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
273: 					{
274: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
275: 						bk_pm_openvela_mailbox_diag_dump();
276: 						// restart_cpu_x();
277: 						break;
278: 					}
279: 					else
280: 					{
281: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
282: 					}
283: 				}
284: 
285: 				retry_cnt++;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
289: 		}
290: 
291: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
292: 		{
293: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
294: 			{
295: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());
296: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
297: 				cpu_x_heartbeat_timeout = 1;
298: 				ap_console_bridge_link_down();
299: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
300: 			}
301: 		}
302: 
303: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
304: 		{
305: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
306: 		}
307: 		else
308: 		{
309: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
310: 		}
311: 	}
312: }

638: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */

711: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
712: 	{
713: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
714: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
715: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
716: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
717: 
718: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
719: 
720: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
721: 		{
722: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
723: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
724: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
725: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
726: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
727: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
728: 
729: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
730: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
731: 			}
732: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
733: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
734: 			return ret_code;
735: 		}
736: 	}
737: 
738: 	return BK_OK;
739: }

741: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
742: 
743: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
744: {
745: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
746: 	u16 			chnl_type;
747: 
748: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
749: 
750: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
751: 
752: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
753: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
754: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
755: #endif
756: 
757: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
758: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
759: 
760: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
761: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
762: 
763: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
764: 
765: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
766: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
767: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
768: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
769: 
770: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
771: 
772: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
773: 
774: 	/*
775: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
776: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
777: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
778: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
779: 	 */
780: 	while(1)
781: 	{
782: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
783: 
784: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
785: 		{
786: 			break;
787: 		}
788: 	}
789: 
790: 	return ret_code;
791: }

794: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
795: /*
796:   * init logical chnanel module.
797:   * return:
798:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
799:   *     failed  : fail code.
800:   *
801:   */
802: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
803: {
804: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
805: 	int				i, j;
806: 
807: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
808: 
809: 	/*
810: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
811: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
812: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
813: 	 * can race here:
814: 	 *
815: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
816: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
817: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
818: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
819: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
820: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
821: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
822: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
823: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
824: 	 *
825: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
826: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
827: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
828: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
829: 	 */
830: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
831: 	{
832: 		return BK_OK;
833: 	}
834: 
835: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
836: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
837: 	{
838: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
839: 		return BK_OK;
840: 	}
841: 
842: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
843: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
844: 	ack_read = 0;
845: 	ack_write = 0;
846: 	ack_count = 0;
847: 	ack_sending = 0;
848: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
849: 	{
850: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
851: 
852: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
853: 
854: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
855: 
856: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
857: 		{
858: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
859: 		}
860: 	}
861: 
862: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
863: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
864: 	{
865: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
866: 		return ret_code;
867: 	}
868: 
869: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
870: 
871: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
872: 	{
873: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
874: 
875: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
876: 	}
877: 
878: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
879: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
880: 
881: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
882: 
883: 	return BK_OK;
884: }

998: /*
999:   * write to logical chnanel.
1000:   * input:
1001:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
1002:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
1003:   * return:
1004:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
1005:   *     failed  : fail code.
1006:   *
1007:   */
1008: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
1009: {
1010: 	u16		write_len;
1011: 
1012: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1013: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1014: 
1015: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1016: 
1017: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1018: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1019: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1020: #endif
1021: 
1022: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1023: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1024: 
1025: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1026: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1027: 
1028: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1029: 
1030: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1031: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1032: 
1033: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1034: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1035: 
1036: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1037: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1038: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1039: 
1040: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1041: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1042: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1043: 	{
1044: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1045: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1046: 	}
1047: 
1048: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1049: 	{
1050: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1051: 
1052: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1053: 	}
1054: 
1055: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
1056: 
1057: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
1058: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));
1059: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
1060: 
1061: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
1062: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
1063: 	__DMB();
1064: 
1065: 	bk_err_t start_ret = mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
1066: 
1067: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1068: 
1069: 	return start_ret;
1070: }

1157: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1158: {
1159: 	u8 phy_idx;
1160: 	u32 poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1161: 
1162: 	/* The CPU1 boot transaction may poll directly while ap_console is also
1163: 	 * scheduled.  Serialize the whole poll pass without holding the channel
1164: 	 * lock across callbacks and physical sends.
1165: 	 */
1166: 	if (s_poll_active)
1167: 	{
1168: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1169: 		return;
1170: 	}
1171: 	s_poll_active = 1;
1172: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1173: 
1174: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1175: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1176: 
1177: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1178: 	{
1179: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1180: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1181: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1182: 		u8 log_idx;
1183: 
1184: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1185: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1186: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1187: 		{
1188: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1189: 			continue;
1190: 		}
1191: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1192: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1193: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1194: 
1195: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1196: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1197: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1198: 			continue;
1199: 
1200: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1201: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1202: 		bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx);
1203: 		phy->recovering = 1;
1204: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
1205: 		failure.hdr.cmd = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1206: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
1207: 		if (logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
1208: 			logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[log_idx].isr_param, &failure);
1209: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx]);
1210: 		mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1211: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT);
1212: 		if (mb_phy_chnl_send_reset(phy_idx, phy->tx_log_chnl) == BK_OK)

57: static void mbox0_reap_slots(u8 dst)
58: {
59: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64: 
65: 	if (mbox0_drv_get_send_count(dst, &fifo_count) != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
66: 		return;
67: 
68: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)
70: 	{
71: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* The hardware FIFO contains pointers into these slots.  Once it has
91: 	 * remained empty for the quarantine interval, the peer has had ample time
92: 	 * to copy every published entry.  ACK-only AP traffic has no later command
93: 	 * fence, so retaining these slots indefinitely exhausts the pool during
94: 	 * RESET/STATE/PWC bring-up.
95: 	 */
96: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
97: 	{
98: 		reaped += slots->ack_used[i] != 0;
99: 		slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
100: 	}
101: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
102: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
103: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
104: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
105: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
106: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
107: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;

258: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
259: {
260: 	u32 address;
261: 	u32 source;
262: 	u32 reaped = 0;
263: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
264: 	u8 ctrl;
265: 	u8 i;
266: 
267: 	if (!msg)
268: 		return;
269: 
270: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
271: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
272: 	{
273: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
274: 		return;
275: 	}
276: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
277: 	{
278: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
279: 		return;
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	address = msg->data[0];
283: 	if (address & 0x3u)
284: 	{
285: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
286: 		return;
287: 	}
288: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
289: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
290: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
291: 	{
292: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
293: 		return;
294: 	}
295: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
296: 	{
297: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
302: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
303: #endif
304: 	__DMB();
305: 	desc = NULL;
306: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
307: 	{
308: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
309: 		{
310: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
311: 			break;
312: 		}
313: 	}
314: 	if (!desc)
315: 	{
316: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
317: 		return;
318: 	}
319: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
320: 	adapter_diag.last_rx_header = desc->data.param0;
321: 	ctrl = (desc->data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
322: 	if (ctrl == 0)
323: 	{
324: 		/* AP serializes ordinary logical commands.  Receiving the next one
325: 		 * proves that it copied the preceding CP transport ACK, providing an
326: 		 * exact lifetime fence even during a continuous UART/PWC burst. */
327: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
328: 		{
329: 			reaped += mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] != 0;
330: 			mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] = 0;
331: 		}
332: 		adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
333: 	}
334: 	desc->source = source;
335: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
336: 	desc->used = 1;
337: 	rx_count++;
338: 	adapter_diag.rx_accepted++;
339: 
340: }

538: 				}
539: 				else
540: 				{
541: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
542: 				}
543: 			}
544: 			else
545: 			{
546: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
547: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
548: 			}
549: 			break;
550: 
551: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:
552: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
553: 			{
554: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
555:

557: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
558: 
559: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;
560: 
561: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
562: 			}
563: 			else
564: 			{
565: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;

567: 			}
568: 			break;
569: 
570: 		case IPC_GET_POWER_SAVE_FLAG:

577: 				mb_ipc_get_power_save_state(p_dst);

579: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;

581: 			break;

583: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)
584: 		case IPC_CPU0_START_USB_CDC:
585: 			{

1221:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
1222:     {
1223:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1224:       return -ENOLINK;
1225:     }
1226: 
1227:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
1228:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
1229:   channel->callback = callback;
1230:   channel->arg = arg;
1231:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
1232:   channel->queued = true;
1233: 
1234:   if (up_cpu_index() == 0)
1235:     {
1236:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1237:     }
1238: 
1239:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1240: 
1241:   /* CPU1 callers only enqueue work.  Physical descriptors to the CP still
1242:    * originate exclusively from logical CPU0.
1243:    */
1244: 
1245:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1246:   return OK;
1247: }

1264: int bk7258_mailbox_start_probe(void)

1280:    * a READY link here would abort a valid state ACK and race the first PWC
1281:    * transaction. */

1283:   if (up_cpu_index() == 0)

1334: int bk7258_mailbox_wait_link_ready(unsigned int timeout_ms)
1335: {
1336:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1337:   clock_t next_probe = clock_systime_ticks();
1338: 
1339:   while (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1340:     {
1341:       clock_t now = clock_systime_ticks();
1342: 
1343:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
1344:         {
1345:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
1346:         }
1347: 
1348:       /* Keep the boot-time probe self-starting even if the initial
1349:        * ABORTING -> PROBING worker wakeup was consumed before RESET was
1350:        * dispatched.  This only marks STATE pending; normal transaction
1351:        * serialization remains in the mailbox workers. */
1352:       if ((int32_t)(now - next_probe) >= 0)
1353:         {
1354:           /* The TX worker can complete STATE between the loop condition and
1355:            * this retry point.  Do not reopen a link that has just become
1356:            * ready. */
1357:           if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1358:             {
1359:               bk7258_mailbox_start_probe();
1360:               bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
1361:             }
1362:           next_probe = now + MSEC2TICK(100);
1363:         }
1364: 
1365:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1366:       nxsig_usleep(1000);
1367:     }
1368: 
1369:   return OK;
1370: }

1419: static int wait_channel(uint8_t logical_channel, unsigned int timeout_ms)
1420: {
1421:   unsigned int index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1422:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1423: 
1424:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1425:     {
1426:       return -EINVAL;
1427:     }
1428: 
1429:   for (;;)
1430:     {
1431:       irqstate_t flags;
1432:       bool queued;
1433:       int result;
1434: 
1435:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1436:       queued = g_channels[index].queued;
1437:       result = g_channels[index].result;
1438:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1439:       if (!queued)
1440:         {
1441:           return result == -EINPROGRESS ? OK : result;
1442:         }
1443: 
1444:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
1445:         {
1446:           bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
1447:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
1448:         }
1449: 
1450:       /* UART link bring-up drains the physical mailbox explicitly because
1451:        * the IRQ may not be dispatched while board_late_initialize() owns the
1452:        * boot transaction.  PWC waits run in the same context and need the
1453:        * same progress guarantee; otherwise CP can process 0x5 and enqueue its
1454:        * ACK while AP remains asleep waiting for an IRQ-side drain. */
1455:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1456:       nxsig_usleep(1000);
1457:     }
1458: }
